name: Termward
subtitle: SSH manager that keeps watch over your servers
description: Official source for Termward, an open-source SSH manager with proactive server health alerts.

apps.name: Termward
apps.subtitle: SSH manager with proactive health alerts
apps.localizedDescription:
Manage many servers over SSH and hear about problems before your users do. Termward checks CPU, memory, disks, load, failed systemd services and Docker containers, and notifies you when a server goes down, turns critical or recovers. Nothing to install on your servers.

• Terminals with an Esc/Tab/Ctrl/arrow key bar
• Run a command on many servers at once
• Create, import and deploy SSH keys
• Reboot or shut down servers
• Host keys verified, secrets kept in the Keychain
• English and Tiếng Việt

Open source (MIT): https://github.com/nguyenquocanhz/termward

versions.localizedDescription: First release: proactive health alerts, terminals, multi-server commands, SSH key management, reboot/shutdown.
